this_accession_role: GSE312393 6-week arm: vastus lateralis of 3 healthy young women before and after a 6-week resistance training program (S5.1.3.p1)
assay: bulk RNA-seq (SMART-Seq mRNA LP), Salmon via nf-core, GRCh38
sample_inclusion: 3 women, biopsy pre and post 6 weeks of leg press/leg extension training (S5.1.3.p1; FIG6 legend K)
primary_estimand: Within-subject expression change after 6 weeks of resistance training, focused on BMP-pathway genes and RFLNA (S2.5.p5, FIG6 K)
planned_contrasts: post-6 weeks vs pre-training (S2.5.p5, FIG6 K; heatmap only, no DEG count)
normalization: tximport counts, DESeq2 VST, gene-scaled heatmaps (S5.2.27.p1)
paper_method: No DE test reported; DESeq2 VST heatmaps (S5.2.27.p1, FIG6 K)
paper_results: BMP-related and RFLNA changes 'maintained at later stages of exercise training' (S2.5.p5)
